datasets.name: Poland - Geoportal standard orthophoto
datasets.attribution: Glowny Urzad Geodezji i Kartografii (GUGiK), Geoportal.gov.pl
datasets.license: Use according to the terms published by Geoportal.gov.pl
datasets.information: Current standard-resolution Polish orthophoto mosaic. The official map service exports one image for the requested terrain area. Cached images expire after 30 days because the service is updated over time.

datasets.name: World - ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2 RGB 2021
datasets.attribution: ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by the ESA WorldCover consortium
datasets.information: Global display-ready true-colour Sentinel-2 mosaic. Acquisition is capped near the product's useful 10 m resolution.

datasets.name: United States (contiguous) - USGS imagery (fast cached ~2 m)
datasets.attribution: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery
datasets.license: Public Domain for the configured contiguous-US NAIP coverage
datasets.information: Official cached USGS imagery basemap, predominantly USDA NAIP over the contiguous United States. Source imagery is primarily 0.6 m, but the published cache ends at zoom 16 and supplies roughly 1.5-2.2 m ground pixels across this coverage. Cached tiles expire after 30 days because the mosaic is updated over time.

datasets.name: United States (contiguous) - USGS NAIP Plus (0.5-2 m)
datasets.attribution: USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery
datasets.license: Public Domain for the configured contiguous-US NAIP coverage
datasets.information: Official dynamic USGS NAIP Plus ImageServer. Choose 4000 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. Source imagery varies from about 0.15 m to 1 m and is served in natural colour. High-resolution requests take longer than the separate cached USGS source.
